description: Workshop combination results: the item each combination makes.

legacy_alias.role: compatibility only; write current semantic ids

columns.name: id
columns.description: Semantic result id; pairs name it.

columns.name: display_name
columns.description: Informational plain-text label; not a key or gameplay value.

columns.name: legacy_id
columns.description: The original record index, which the combined item keeps as its sub id. A blade's item id is the same; a shield's or armor piece's is this + 126. Runs from 0 without gaps.

columns.name: model
columns.description: A combined shield's WEP model number (OBJ/<two hex digits>.WEP, converted to models/weapons/<two hex digits>.gltf). Combining armor never reads it; armor pieces keep 0.

columns.name: category
columns.description: The item category: shield results use shield, armor results the armor pieces (the armor material rules match helm to glove); none is the empty result.

columns.name: gem_slots
columns.description: How many gems a combined shield holds. Armor pieces hold none; the armor book's copies of the shield records (legacy ids 1-16) also keep 0, as no armor pair makes them.

columns.name: strength
columns.description: Base strength, before the material's bonus.

columns.name: intelligence
columns.description: Base intelligence, before the material's bonus.

columns.name: agility
columns.description: Base agility, before the material's bonus.
